november envelopes & prayer cards : as well as christmas envelopes and calendars will be delivered to households in the parish in the next week or so. many thanks to the contact people in each area for their co-operation. remenbering our loved ones: november is a special time when we remember those we have loved and lost. but remembrance continues throughout the year. in-memory.ie helps families keep the memories of loved ones together, with photographs, stories, videos and messages, as well as annual reminders of important birthdays and anniversaries. find out more :
